name: mljar-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is mljar-supervised, an automated machine learning package for tabular data: the
`AutoML` class with its Explain, Perform, Compete and Optuna modes, the training steps it runs, automatic
preprocessing (missing values, categorical, text and datetime columns, scaling, target encoding, Golden Features,
feature selection), validation strategies, hyperparameter tuning, early-stopping callbacks, evaluation metrics,
ensembling and the results directory it saves and loads.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is the AutoML core of the supervised package (supervised/__init__.py, supervised/automl.py, supervised/base_automl.py, supervised/exceptions.py, supervised/model_framework.py and supervised/ensemble.py), the packages supervised/preprocessing/, supervised/validation/ and supervised/callbacks/, every module of supervised/tuner/ except the supervised/tuner/optuna/ package, and every module of supervised/utils/ except additional_plots.py, automl_plots.py, leaderboard_plots.py, learning_curves.py, report_structured.py and shap.py. The documentation in scope is the pages docs/docs/features/automl.md, docs/docs/features/modes.md, docs/docs/features/preprocessing.md, docs/docs/features/golden_features.md, docs/docs/features/features_selection.md, docs/docs/features/custom-eval-metric.md, docs/docs/features/save-and-load-models.md and docs/docs/features/stacking-ensemble.md, together with the mod
